process: Not level-based (one table), so no retrofit. One independent review round found no BLOCKING or MEDIUM issue, so the game is unchanged; the record adds a short browser check.
independentProbes: Pinball Pocket is a score game with no win condition: the run ends as a loss when the third ball drains, so blind play cannot win. Over 400 random-flipper games no ball drained straight off the plunger (shortest ball life 5.0 s, median 8.4 s). Across 1,400+ games and 4,680 placed-ball cases no ball tunnelled through a flipper or wall, left the table or ran forever. A reaction-limited flipper bot using only public state averaged 13.0k at 0.25 s and 17.6k at 0.35 s, two to three times the averages of idle (0), mashing and random keys (about 0-10k). Same-input runs repeat exactly, a 300-seed hostile-input fuzz threw nothing and ended once, EN/ZH text fits, and two touch buttons hold both flippers independently.
openNotes: A ball placed at about (394.5, 202.2), between the launch-lane wall and the right slingshot rail, can rest forever; no natural play reached it.
A finger on the canvas overrides a held flipper touch button; the dedicated left and right buttons handle two fingers correctly.
The 'STAR BONUS!' banner draws over the mid-table ball path for 1.5 s, and ramp shots are rare.

browser.method: Official Claude in Chrome extension, local server; synthetic in-page keys; only DOM text and the canvas were read.
observed: Chinese: Start showed the STAR table with 3 balls and multiplier x1; Space launched the ball into play and both flippers rose on Left and Right.
The batch 1 acceptance record covers the English run, a full game to the third drain, restart and the phone frame.
